create.name: Susannah Kenton
create.bio:
Susannah Kenton is a meditation, breath and prayer guide and EFT tapping practitioner based in Christchurch, New Zealand. Before turning to this work she made her living on stage and behind the microphone as an actress, singer and voice artist, and she has written or co-written seven books, among them a children's story, Anna and the Whale. Her own training spans shamanic healing, hypnotherapy, EFT, space clearing, tantra, mindfulness and breathwork, and she names Byron Katie, Eckhart Tolle, Denise Linn and Michael Beckwith among the teachers who shaped her.

At the heart of her teaching is affirmative prayer, in which the person praying speaks as one with the divine rather than petitioning a distant God, woven together with tapping, coherence breathing and guided journeys. Her short audio courses cover prayer practice, a guided writing method for receiving inner guidance, a substance-free journey modelled on plant medicine ceremony, and finding soulful work. One-to-one Light-Up Sessions on Zoom open with prayer and then use tapping to loosen limiting beliefs. She has led workshops for groups such as the Institute of Noetic Sciences and the Maine Media Workshops, offers sacred ceremony and blessings at weddings, funerals and gatherings, and hosts a weekly live circle on Insight Timer.

courses.title: Light-Up Session
courses.description: A one-hour private call on Zoom. She opens with a spoken prayer and then uses EFT tapping to work on the beliefs that are holding you back, so you finish clearer about what to do next.

courses.title: Move Mountains With Prayer
courses.description: An eight-day audio course of about ten minutes a day that teaches affirmative prayer, a way of praying as one with the divine rather than asking an outside authority. Lessons build step by step until you can pray in your own words, alone or with others.

courses.title: Streaming from Source
courses.description: Three short audio lessons that lead into a guided writing practice for receiving inner guidance. Breath, prayer and tapping prepare the ground before you put your question on paper and let the answers flow.

courses.title: The Virtual Plant Medicine Retreat
courses.description: A three-day audio retreat that borrows the shape of a plant medicine ceremony without any substances. Tapping and a heart-clearing meditation lead to a guided shamanic journey for vision and direction.

courses.title: Quit Your Day Job
courses.description: A ten-day audio course for people who want work that feels more meaningful. It uses tapping, meditation, prayer, journaling and simple ceremony to loosen old stories about work and build the confidence to move on.

courses.title: Susannah's Abundance Bundle
courses.description: Five recorded tracks on moving from a sense of lack towards trust and gratitude: a tapping round, two guided meditations, a spoken prayer and a short breath practice.

free_resources.title: Susannah Kenton on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Guided meditations, breath practices, tapping rounds and prayers, plus her weekly live circles. The single tracks are free to hear.

free_resources.title: Tap Yourself Free Mini Series
free_resources.description: A free short video series and PDF workbook that teaches the basic EFT tapping points and how to run a round on your own. Sent by email after sign-up.

sprint.tier_evidence: Insight Timer 7k (profile, 31 Oct 2026); YouTube 75 subscribers (channel page); Facebook count not readable without login; no Instagram linked from her site → ~7k total → local_hero
flags: A large part of her site is nutrition and weight-loss coaching ('Eat to Thrive', 'Can You Love Yourself Lean?'); none of that is in the plan, and the bio does not mention it.

Her bestselling co-authored book Raw Energy (with her mother, Leslie Kenton) and its follow-ups are raw-food nutrition titles, not spiritual teaching, and sold on health; no books listed. Anna and the Whale is a children's book; not added.
She offers workshops 'online or in person' on request, but no regular in-person base or class was found; availability set to worldwide.
Insight Timer bio could only be partly quoted by WebFetch; bio check relied mainly on her own site pages.
Her four Insight Timer courses are the same four courses sold on her own site; listed once each with her own-site URLs.
Her YouTube channel is small (75 subscribers); videos were picked for teaching content rather than views.
left_out: Susannah's Healing Bundle: includes a cancer meditation (health claim).
Susannah's De-Stress Bundle and Sleep bundle: sold on stress and sleep.
